verdict.rationale: The Department publishes a downloadable Reemployment Tax XML Package containing Florida XML Schemas and an XPath document for its electronic file-and-pay program for large data files. That is a first-party, machine-readable interface spec, but it describes a bulk file format, not an OpenAPI-style API, and it covers only reemployment tax. The batch enrollment technical specifications are not downloadable and must be requested by email, and the registration application is an authenticated, login-gated web app. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec describing callable endpoints, coverage beyond reemployment-tax file uploads, freely downloadable batch specs, and any independent or hands-on confirmation that the schemas are usable programmatically.
